summary: Correct and minimal fix for the RenameModel-with-fixed-db_table noop bug; when old and new db_table match, the operation short-circuits before touching the main table, related-object FKs, and M2M tables, all of which key off db_table and thus need no change. Matches Django's actual accepted fix.

issues.description: Comment 'Don't alter when a table name is not changed.' is slightly terse; could note that related FK/M2M alterations are also intentionally skipped since they derive from db_table. Non-blocking.
